sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_KOLON_RFQ_HEADER SET IF_FLAG = #NEXT_ST# , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND IF_FLAG = #PREV_ST# AND BUYER IN (SELECT DISTINCT(TEXT1) AS BUYER FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C002' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKOLOG001' AND TEXT5 = '0110' AND TRIM(TEXT1) IS NOT NULL)
